description: This file contains unit tests for the litellm.types.utils module, testing various data models and functions related to usage metrics, hidden parameters, and utility classes.

classes.name: HiddenParams
classes.description: A class representing hidden parameters, specifically used for testing.

classes.name: ChatCompletionDeltaToolCall
classes.description: A class representing a delta update in chat completion with associated function call data.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: A class representing a function call with arguments and name.

classes.name: Choices
classes.description: A class representing choices options for completions.

classes.name: CompletionTokensDetailsWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class for details about completion tokens, used in usage metrics.

classes.name: PromptTokensDetailsWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class for details about prompt tokens, used in usage metrics.

classes.name: Usage
classes.description: A class representing usage metrics including token counts and details.

methods.name: test_hidden_params_response_ms()
methods.description: Tests setting and serializing the _response_ms attribute in HiddenParams.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_delta_tool_call()
methods.description: Tests creation and validation of ChatCompletionDeltaToolCall object.

methods.name: test_empty_choices()
methods.description: Verifies that Choices object can be instantiated.

methods.name: test_usage_dump()
methods.description: Tests dumping and reloading Usage object with nested details.

methods.name: test_usage_completion_tokens_details_text_tokens()
methods.description: Tests the correct handling of text_tokens in Usage's completion_tokens_details.
